India’s Ball Bearing Market Today

India’s manufacturing is booming today thanks to strong domestic demand and the ‘Make in India’ campaign. As factories and construction expand across the country, local ball bearing makers are busier than ever keeping everything rolling.

Heavy Concentration in Automotive and Agriculture: India makes more motorcycles and tractors than any other country in the world, plus a massive number of commercial trucks. Because of this, local bearing factories naturally focus on high-volume, budget-friendly (https://www.zmsbearing.com/ball-bearings/deep-groove-ball-bearings/) deep groove ball bearings—built mainly for two-wheelers, farm equipment, light vehicles, and everyday electric fans.”

Prominent Industrial Clusters: If you look at where bearings are actually made in India, three regions stand out: Gujarat (Rajkot and Ahmedabad) is the beating heart of local private makers; Maharashtra (Pune and Mumbai) focuses on big automotive brands; and Tamil Nadu (Chennai) powers the industrial south.

Dual Market Structure (Domestic Champions vs. Multinationals): Today, the market is shared between two big groups: strong Indian pioneers like NBC (NEI) and NRB, and global giants like SKF, Schaeffler, and Timken. These international brands have built massive local plants in India, not only to supply the booming domestic market but also to ship standard bearings around the world.

Engineering Challenges & Sourcing Realities: Where does local supply fall short? While India is great for high-volume automotive orders, high-precision and specialty bearings are harder to come by. If you need whisper-quiet electric motor bearings (EMQ / Z3V3), (https://www.zmsbearing.com/ball-bearings/angular-contact-ball-bearings/miniature-angular-contact-bearings/) tiny miniature sizes, or (https://www.zmsbearing.com/ball-bearings/deep-groove-ball-bearings/stainless-steel-ball-bearings/) stainless steel options, local choices are limited. Plus, because many factories still rely on imported bearing steel (SAE 52100), production lead times can sometimes stretch longer than expected.

Strategic Global Diversification: With everyone exploring ‘China + 1’ strategies today, India has become a popular place to diversify. However, experienced buyers know it’s rarely an either/or choice. The smartest sourcing teams balance both: they rely on Indian suppliers for regional automotive orders, while partnering with established Chinese makers to cover (https://www.zmsbearing.com/product/) full product sizes, achieve tighter precision, and avoid long factory lead times.”

1. (https://www.skf.com/in/organisation/about-skf-india/skf-india-ltd) SKF India Ltd.

SKF (Svenska Kullagerfabriken) is a Swedish multinational company, but SKF India Ltd. is the undisputed market leader in the Indian bearing industry. They have been present in India since 1923 and are highly regarded for their premium quality, technological innovation, and massive distribution network.

Manufacturing Footprint in India:
SKF has a very strong local manufacturing presence to cater to both domestic and export markets. Their key manufacturing facilities in India include:

Pune (Maharashtra): This is their flagship and oldest manufacturing facility in India (started in 1965). It produces a wide range of ball and roller bearings.

Bengaluru (Karnataka): Focuses on deep groove ball bearings and also houses the Global Technical Centre India (GTCI), which drives R&D and innovation.

Haridwar (Uttarakhand): Specifically set up to manufacture deep groove ball bearings, primarily catering to the robust two-wheeler and automotive sectors in North India.

Key Products Manufactured:
While they make almost every type of bearing, their ball bearing portfolio includes:

Automotive Hub Bearing Units

Deep Groove Ball Bearings (DGBB)

(https://www.zmsbearing.com/ball-bearings/angular-contact-ball-bearings/) Angular Contact Ball Bearings

Self-aligning Ball Bearings

Thrust Ball Bearings

2.Schaeffler India Ltd. (FAG Bearings)

Schaeffler is a massive German mobility and industrial supplier. In India, they operate under Schaeffler India Ltd., which encompasses three major product brands: FAG (ball and roller bearings), INA (needle roller and linear bearings), and LuK (clutch systems). For ball bearings, the FAG brand is SKF’s biggest direct competitor in the Indian market, known for exceptional German engineering and precision.

Manufacturing Footprint in India:
Schaeffler has invested heavily in Indian manufacturing to localize production. Their key bearing plants include:

Maneja (Vadodara, Gujarat): This is their oldest and one of their largest plants in India, primarily focused on FAG ball bearings and (https://www.zmsbearing.com/roller-bearings/cylindrical-roller-bearings/) cylindrical roller bearings.

Savli (Vadodara, Gujarat): A state-of-the-art facility that focuses heavily on low-friction Deep Groove Ball Bearings (DGBB) and (https://www.zmsbearing.com/large-diameter-bearings/) large-size bearings for industrial applications.

Talegaon (Pune, Maharashtra): While primarily focused on INA engine and transmission components, it supports their wider automotive footprint.

Hosur (Tamil Nadu): Focuses on clutch systems and automotive components.

Key Ball Bearing Products Manufactured:
Under the FAG brand, they produce a massive variety of ball bearings, including:

(https://www.zmsbearing.com/mounted-bearings/pillow-block-bearings/) Insert Bearings (Housing units)

Generation C Deep Groove Ball Bearings (highly popular in India for low noise and low friction)

Angular Contact Ball Bearings

Spindle Bearings (High-precision bearings for machine tools)

Self-aligning Ball Bearings

3.National Engineering Industries Limited (NBC Bearings)

National Engineering Industries Ltd. (NEIL), which manufactures under the brand name NBC Bearings, is a part of the CK Birla Group. Founded in 1946, NBC is India’s largest homegrown (Indian-owned) bearing manufacturer. They produce over 200 million bearings annually in more than 2,300 variants. If SKF and FAG represent European engineering in India, NBC represents the ultimate “Make in India” success story.

Manufacturing Footprint in India:
NBC operates world-class manufacturing facilities spread across India, heavily automated and focused on high-volume production:

Jaipur (Rajasthan): This is their headquarters and their oldest, largest manufacturing plant.

Newai (Rajasthan): A highly advanced facility focusing on high-volume production.

Manesar (Haryana): Strategically located near major automotive hubs (like Maruti Suzuki and Hero MotoCorp) to supply automotive bearings efficiently.

Vadodara (Gujarat): Their newest state-of-the-art facility, situated in a major industrial corridor.

Key Ball Bearing Products Manufactured:
NBC manufactures a vast array of ball bearings designed for both everyday use and extreme conditions:

Specialty custom ball bearings for OEMs

Deep Groove Ball Bearings (ranging from 10mm to 2000mm outer diameter)

Angular Contact Ball Bearings

Self-aligning Ball Bearings

Thrust Ball Bearings

4.Timken India

Timken India is a subsidiary of The Timken Company (USA), a global leader in engineered bearings and power transmission products. Timken entered the Indian market in 1987 as a joint venture with Tata Steel (originally named Tata-Timken Ltd.), before becoming a fully owned subsidiary in 1999. Today, Timken India is highly regarded for supplying extremely durable bearings for heavy-duty and high-stress environments.

Manufacturing Footprint in India:
Timken has expanded its manufacturing capabilities in India significantly, both through organic growth and acquisitions:

Jamshedpur (Jharkhand): This is their premier and oldest manufacturing plant in India, set up originally with Tata. It produces a wide range of bearings and components.

Chennai (Tamil Nadu): A state-of-the-art facility located in the Mahindra World City, focusing on manufacturing bearings for both domestic and export markets.

Bharuch (Gujarat): Timken acquired ABC Bearings in 2018, bringing this plant into their fold. This acquisition significantly boosted their capacity to produce high-volume bearings for the Indian automotive sector.

Key Ball Bearing Products Manufactured:
While they dominate the roller bearing market, their ball bearing lineup is premium and highly reliable, often utilized in critical applications:

Corrosion-Resistant Ball Bearings (for food processing and harsh environments)

Deep Groove Ball Bearings (ranging from miniature to large industrial sizes)

Angular Contact Ball Bearings

Precision Ball Bearings (used in machine tools and aerospace)

5.NSK Bearings India Pvt. Ltd.

NSK was founded in 1916 and produced the first ball bearings made in Japan. Today, they are a global powerhouse. In India, NSK Bearings India Pvt. Ltd. (established in 2007) has grown rapidly, bringing world-class Japanese engineering, ultra-precision, and “Zero Defect” manufacturing philosophies to the Indian market. They are highly favored by both Indian and multinational OEMs operating in the country.

Manufacturing Footprint in India:
NSK has strategically located its manufacturing and technical centers to serve the massive automotive and industrial hubs in India:

Chennai (Oragadam, Tamil Nadu): This is NSK’s primary bearing manufacturing facility in India. Located in the “Detroit of India,” this state-of-the-art plant produces millions of high-quality ball bearings annually.

Chennai Technology Centre: NSK also established a local R&D and technical support center here to customize bearing designs for the specific needs (and rougher conditions) of the Indian market.

(Note: They also have a major joint venture called Rane NSK Steering Systems with plants in Chennai, Bawal, and Pantnagar, though this focuses on steering columns rather than standalone bearings).

Key Ball Bearing Products Manufactured:
NSK is famous globally for its ball bearing technology, particularly in high-speed and low-noise applications:

Miniature and Instrument Ball Bearings

Deep Groove Ball Bearings (Their bread and butter—known for exceptionally low friction)

Angular Contact Ball Bearings (High precision for machine tools)

Self-Aligning Ball Bearings

Automotive Hub Wheel Bearings

6. (https://www.ntnbearing.in/) NTN Bearing India Pvt. Ltd.

Founded in Japan in 1918, NTN is one of the most prominent bearing manufacturers in the world. In India, NTN Bearing India Pvt. Ltd. has established a massive presence. While they are globally famous for being the largest manufacturer of Constant Velocity Joints (CVJs), their ball bearing division is equally formidable. They are deeply trusted by automotive OEMs for providing components that offer long life in highly demanding, compact spaces.

Manufacturing Footprint in India:
NTN has heavily localized its production to serve the Indian market rapidly and efficiently. Their primary manufacturing hub is:

Bawal (Haryana): This massive, state-of-the-art manufacturing facility is strategically located in the heart of North India’s automotive belt. It focuses heavily on producing automotive hub bearings, ball bearings, and CVJs.

Engineering & Sales Network: Aside from manufacturing in Bawal, NTN has established robust technical and sales support centers across major industrial hubs like Chennai, Pune, and Manesar to work directly with Indian R&D teams.

Key Ball Bearing Products Manufactured:
NTN produces a highly specialized range of ball bearings, with a strong emphasis on automotive and high-precision applications:

(https://www.zmsbearing.com/ball-bearings/deep-groove-ball-bearings/micro-miniature-bearings/) Miniature and Extra-Small Ball Bearings

Deep Groove Ball Bearings (Standard and clearance-optimized for electric motors)

Automotive Wheel Hub Bearings (Generation 1, 2, and 3 hub units, which utilize specialized ball bearing designs)

Angular Contact Ball Bearings

Sensor-equipped Ball Bearings (Crucial for modern ABS and traction control systems)

7. NRB Bearings Ltd.

Founded in 1965, NRB Bearings was the first company to manufacture needle roller bearings in India. Over the decades, they have evolved into a comprehensive bearing manufacturer and a true Indian multinational. Today, they produce a massive volume of high-quality ball bearings. It is a well-known industry fact that over 90% of vehicles running on Indian roads contain an NRB bearing.

Manufacturing Footprint in India:
NRB has a highly widespread and strategic manufacturing footprint across India, allowing them to be right next door to major automotive hubs:

Maharashtra (Thane, Aurangabad, Jalna, Waluj): The heart of NRB’s manufacturing operations. These multiple plants produce millions of ball, needle, and roller bearings.

Pantnagar (Uttarakhand): Strategically set up to supply the massive automotive manufacturing cluster in North India (especially two-wheeler giants).

Hyderabad (Telangana): Focuses on specialized bearing production.

R&D Centre (Thane): NRB boasts a world-class, government-recognized Research and Development center that designs and tests bearings specifically for tough Indian conditions.

Key Ball Bearing Products Manufactured:
While needle bearings are their namesake, their ball bearing portfolio is extensive and highly customized:

Wide Inner Ring Ball Bearings

Deep Groove Ball Bearings (Widely used in two-wheeler engines and transmissions)

Specialized Automotive Ball Bearings (Custom-designed for specific OEM engine requirements)

Bottom Roller Bearings (Used heavily in the textile industry)

8.Tata Bearings (A Division of Tata Steel)

Unlike the other companies on this list which are standalone bearing corporations, Tata Bearings is a strategic profit center and division of Tata Steel, one of the world’s largest steel producers. Established in the early 1980s, Tata Bearings leverages the massive metallurgical expertise of its parent company to produce highly durable ball bearings. The brand is synonymous with reliability and is deeply trusted by Indian consumers and mechanics alike.

Manufacturing Footprint in India:
Tata Bearings operates its primary, highly automated manufacturing facility in eastern India:

Kharagpur (West Bengal): This state-of-the-art plant has a production capacity of over 40 million bearings annually. The facility is equipped with advanced Japanese and European machinery for grinding, honing, and assembly, ensuring world-class precision.

They also utilize a vast network of consignment agents and retail touchpoints across the country, making their products highly accessible.

Key Ball Bearing Products Manufactured:
Tata Bearings focuses heavily on high-volume ball bearings used in everyday applications:

(https://www.zmsbearing.com/ball-bearings/angular-contact-ball-bearings/double-row-angular-contact-ball-bearings/) Double Row Angular Contact Ball Bearings (For automotive wheel hubs)

Deep Groove Ball Bearings (Their flagship product, produced in massive quantities)

Magneto Bearings (Widely used in two-wheeler engines)

(https://www.zmsbearing.com/automative-bearings/clutch-release-bearings/) Clutch Release Bearings (For passenger cars and commercial vehicles)

9.JTEKT India Limited (Koyo Bearings)

JTEKT Corporation is a Japanese global giant formed by the merger of Koyo Seiko (a premier bearing manufacturer) and Toyoda Machine Works. In India, they previously operated as a joint venture known as Sona Koyo Steering Systems, but it is now fully integrated as JTEKT India Limited. Under the Koyo brand, they manufacture some of the most reliable and highly engineered ball bearings in the world, with a very strong backing from the Toyota Group.

Manufacturing Footprint in India:
JTEKT has a massive, highly automated manufacturing footprint in India, primarily clustered around major automotive hubs to ensure just-in-time delivery:

Bawal & Dharuhera (Haryana): These are their flagship manufacturing facilities in North India. They produce a massive volume of bearings and steering systems here.

Gurugram (Haryana): Serves as a major production hub and corporate base.

Sanand (Gujarat) & Chennai (Tamil Nadu): Strategically located to serve the automotive giants in western and southern India.

Technical Centre: They have a dedicated R&D center in India that works closely with Japanese engineers to localize production without dropping a single percentage point in quality.

Key Ball Bearing Products Manufactured:
While they make all types of bearings, their ball bearing division is highly specialized for automotive applications:

Deep Groove Ball Bearings (Standard and Miniature)

Steering Column Bearings (They are the undisputed global masters of this specific bearing)

Angular Contact Ball Bearings

Water Pump Bearings

Wheel Hub Bearing Units

10. (https://zklindia.com/) ZKL Bearings (India) Pvt. Ltd.

ZKL is the biggest manufacturer of large-scale and special bearings in Central Europe, headquartered in Brno, Czech Republic. They have been supplying to India for decades. ZKL Bearings India Pvt. Ltd. was established to solidify their massive presence in the subcontinent. While brands like SKF and NSK dominate the automotive sector, ZKL is a legendary name in India’s heavy industrial and infrastructure sectors.

Operational & Manufacturing Footprint in India:
While ZKL’s core heavy-forging and manufacturing plants remain in the Czech Republic, their Indian footprint is massive in terms of technical integration and distribution:

Kolkata & Mumbai (Headquarters & Hubs): ZKL India operates heavily out of these major industrial and commercial hubs, managing a vast network of authorized distributors across the country.

Localized Technical Centers: ZKL doesn’t just import boxes; they have dedicated Indian engineering teams that work directly with Indian steel mills and power plants to provide root-cause failure analysis, customized bearing selection, and installation support.

Massive Warehousing: To counter import lead times, they maintain massive centralized inventories in India to ensure heavy industries don’t face downtime.

Key Ball Bearing Products:
ZKL is famous for big bearings. While they make standard sizes, their strength lies in medium-to-large industrial ball bearings:

Special clearance ball bearings for high-temperature environments.

Large-size Deep Groove Ball Bearings

Heavy-duty Angular Contact Ball Bearings (used in heavy pumps and compressors)

Thrust Ball Bearings (designed to take massive axial loads in vertical shafts)

11.Austin Engineering Company Ltd. (AEC Bearings)

Established in 1973, Austin Engineering Company Ltd. (AEC) is a premier Indian bearing manufacturer headquartered in Gujarat. While they might not have the massive consumer brand visibility of Tata or SKF, AEC is highly respected in B2B engineering circles. They have built a strong reputation for producing high-quality, heavy-duty bearings that are heavily exported to highly demanding markets like the USA, UK, and Europe.

Manufacturing Footprint in India:
AEC’s manufacturing operations are centralized, allowing for strict quality control and high flexibility:

Junagadh (Gujarat): AEC operates a massive, fully integrated manufacturing complex here. Unlike companies that only assemble parts, AEC does everything in-house—from forging and turning to heat treatment and precision grinding.

TUV Rheinland Certified: Their facilities maintain strict international quality standards (IATF 16949 and ISO 9001), which is why they are a trusted export partner for Western countries.

Key Ball Bearing Products Manufactured:
AEC produces a comprehensive range of ball bearings, often focusing on larger sizes and heavy-duty applications:

(https://www.zmsbearing.com/custom-bearings/) Special Purpose / Custom Ball Bearings

Deep Groove Ball Bearings

Angular Contact Ball Bearings (Single and Double Row)

Thrust Ball Bearings

12. ZNL Bearings

Headquartered in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, ZNL Bearings is a dynamic and fast-growing Indian bearing manufacturer. While the multinational giants focus heavily on supplying directly to OEMs (Original Equipment Manufacturers), ZNL has carved out a massive, highly successful niche by dominating the industrial aftermarket and global export sectors. They are known for providing an incredibly wide range of highly reliable bearings at a very competitive price point.

Manufacturing Footprint in India:
Gujarat is the heartland of Indian bearing manufacturing, and ZNL leverages this ecosystem perfectly:

Ahmedabad (Gujarat): ZNL operates out of modern, ISO 9001-certified manufacturing and testing facilities. They utilize advanced CNC and grinding machinery to ensure their bearings meet strict international standards.

Massive Export Network: ZNL is a true “Make in India for the World” success story. They export a huge percentage of their production to over 60 countries across Europe, South America, the Middle East, and Africa. To support this, they maintain massive warehousing facilities to ensure rapid global shipping.

Key Ball Bearing Products Manufactured:
ZNL boasts one of the most comprehensive, ready-to-ship catalogues in the industry, with a strong focus on industrial ball bearings:

Angular Contact Ball Bearings

Deep Groove Ball Bearings (Manufactured in massive volumes for general machinery)

Insert Ball Bearings & Pillow Block Units (This is a huge strength for ZNL; their mounted bearing units are highly popular)

Self-Aligning Ball Bearings

13.RBC Bearings Pvt. Ltd.

Founded in 1919 in the USA, RBC Bearings is a global leader in highly engineered, precision bearings and components. Unlike SKF or Tata, which produce millions of standard bearings for everyday cars and ceiling fans, RBC focuses on the extremes of engineering. They are the masters of bearings that go into fighter jets, spacecraft, robotic arms, and complex medical devices. Through their Indian subsidiary, they are deeply involved in India’s booming aerospace and defense sectors.

Manufacturing Footprint in India:
To support their global supply chain and tap into India’s growing high-tech manufacturing sector, RBC has established a strong local presence:

Pune (Maharashtra): Pune is one of India’s premier engineering and IT hubs. RBC operates a manufacturing and engineering facility here. This plant is not about churning out massive volumes; instead, it focuses on high-precision, highly complex manufacturing processes required for aerospace and specialized industrial applications.

Global Sourcing & Engineering: The Indian facility also acts as a critical engineering and sourcing hub for RBC’s global operations, integrating Indian engineering talent into their worldwide network.

Key Ball Bearing Products Manufactured:
RBC’s ball bearing portfolio is highly specialized and niche:

(https://www.zmsbearing.com/custom-bearings/) Custom Engineered Ball Bearings.
(Note: Globally, they are also famous for spherical plain bearings and rod ends under their Heim® brand).

(https://www.zmsbearing.com/ball-bearings/thin-section-bearings/) Thin Section Ball Bearings: (This is their superpower. These bearings have extremely thin cross-sections, saving massive amounts of weight and space in robotics and aerospace).

Airframe Control Ball Bearings (Used in the wings and flight control systems of aircraft).

Precision Ground Ball Bearings (For high-speed machine tools).

14.ABC Bearings Ltd.

Founded in 1961, ABC Bearings Ltd. was historically one of India’s most prominent and respected homegrown bearing manufacturers. For decades, they were a powerhouse in the Indian automotive and commercial vehicle sectors. However, in a massive industry move in 2018, ABC Bearings was officially acquired by and merged into Timken India Ltd. While the ABC corporate entity merged with Timken, the legacy, the manufacturing infrastructure, and the trust associated with the ABC name remain a vital part of the Indian bearing landscape.

Manufacturing Footprint in India (The ABC Legacy):
Before the Timken acquisition, ABC built highly capable manufacturing facilities that are now critical assets for Timken’s operations in India:

Bharuch (Gujarat): This was ABC’s flagship, state-of-the-art manufacturing plant. It is a massive facility that heavily boosted Timken’s local production capacity.

Dehradun (Uttarakhand): Another key facility strategically located to serve the robust automotive manufacturing belt in North India.

Key Ball Bearing Products Manufactured:
While ABC was globally famous for its Tapered Roller Bearings (TRBs) and Cylindrical Roller Bearings, their ball bearing and general bearing portfolio was highly trusted by OEMs:

Deep Groove Ball Bearings (For automotive and industrial applications)

(https://www.zmsbearing.com/slewing-bearings/) Slewing Bearings (Large-diameter bearings used in heavy earthmoving equipment)

Automotive Wheel Bearings

Clutch Release Bearings

15.Galaxy Bearings Limited

(https://bimite.co.in/) .Established in 1990, Galaxy Bearings Ltd. is a publicly listed Indian company headquartered in Rajkot, Gujarat. Rajkot is famous for being one of India’s most significant engineering and auto-component manufacturing hubs, and Galaxy is one of its crown jewels. While they are globally renowned for their tapered and cylindrical roller bearings, their ball bearing division is highly robust, specifically engineered to withstand the punishing loads of commercial vehicles and heavy machinery.

Manufacturing Footprint in India:
Galaxy Bearings operates out of a highly advanced, fully integrated manufacturing complex:

Rajkot (Gujarat): Their state-of-the-art manufacturing facility is IATF 16949 and ISO 9001 certified. What makes this plant special is its comprehensive in-house capabilities—from forging and turning to advanced heat treatment and precision grinding. Having everything under one roof ensures strict quality control and faster production cycles.

Global Reach from Local Soil: Despite being a purely Indian manufacturer, a massive portion of their production from Rajkot is exported to over 30 countries, including the USA, Europe, and the Middle East.

Key Ball Bearing Products Manufactured:
